root_idea.summary: The root centers on strength, especially the strongest side or supporting part of a thing.
root_idea.development: From the idea of a strong side or support, the root develops meanings of relying on or inclining toward something, firmness and stability, and various concrete and technical applications.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form رَكَنَ.
Displayed under the normalized noun citation form رُكْنٌ.

senses.definition: To incline toward; to lean upon or rely on.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى for turning or leaning toward a person or thing, including a very slight inclination. A reported passive Form IV reading of the Quranic passage expresses being made to incline; it is an alternate reading, not a separate QAC form group.

senses.definition: A strong support or source of power, including powerful backing or a people or party to whom one can resort.
senses.usage_conditions: In آوِي إلى رُكْنٍ شديدٍ, it denotes the strong backing or source of might sought for protection or support.

senses.definition: Supporting forces, followers, or a party by which a powerful person is strengthened.
senses.usage_conditions: In بِرُكْنِهِ, the noun refers to the forces or supporters accompanying and strengthening him, rather than to a physical corner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling tenaciously to a dwelling or place of alighting and not relinquish it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct use referring to remaining attached to a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be inaccessible or difficult of access; of a mountain, to have high or strong sides, and of a person, to be firm, steady, grave, or calm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mountain and personal applications are distinct extensions of firmness and strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become firm or strong and difficult of access.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or thing that acquires firmness, strength, or inaccessibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive to become grave, steady, sedate, or calm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or effortful comportment use, distinct from simply being firm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large field-rat or a common rat or mouse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal animal term distinguished by its vocalization from رُكْنٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or outward part of a thing, especially its strongest side; a corner or angle of a house, room, palace, mountain, or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The physical sense concerns a side, extremity, corner, or angle on which or by which something is situated or supported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stay or support of any kind, or a means by which something is strengthened, such as dominion or an army.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical extension of the support sense, not limited to the specific Quranic support and forces constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A noble or high-ranking person, especially a leading member of his people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This denotes a person viewed as a prominent source of standing or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The limbs or members of a human being by which work is done or things are accomplished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used collectively of bodily members such as the hands, arms, feet, or legs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A momentous, formidable, or terrible thing, affair, event, or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for something of great magnitude or seriousness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In technical usage, the essence or essential part without which a thing cannot subsist or be complete; hence a fundamental element of a ritual or other system.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an intrinsic constituent, including a fundamental of worship whose omission invalidates it; distinguished from an external condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain with high or strong sides, inaccessible or difficult to access.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a mountain's strong, elevated sides and resulting inaccessibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who is firm, steady, grave, sedate, or calm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative personal application of firmness and composure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great headman or chief of a village or town.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A title for a prominent local leader.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leather vessel for water, or a tub used for washing clothes and similar things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers both the water vessel and the washing tub described in the lexical evidence.
A descriptive passive-participial adjective for a thing provided with or characterized by أَرْكَان.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an udder: large and expanded, filling the surrounding groins and not very long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of an udder, including that of a she-camel, when its size and shape give it pronounced sides or fullness.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Inclining, relying, and slight inclination are covered by the Quranic verb sense.
Clinging to a dwelling is represented as a separate Classical verb use.
Inaccessibility and strong mountain sides are represented.
Firmness and composure in a person are included under the related adjectival state.
A reported meaning 'to make like' is immediately rejected in favor of زكّن, so it cannot be assigned confidently to this root.
The reported passive Form IV Quranic reading is preserved in the verb usage conditions.
Becoming firm, strong, or inaccessible is represented under تَرَكَّنَ.
Striving for steadiness or calm is represented separately.
The rat or mouse meaning is represented.
Physical side, strongest side, corner, and angle are represented.
Support, strengthening forces, supported people, prominent persons, and human limbs are all accounted for.
Might and resistance in the Quranic support construction are covered by the strong-support sense.
The figurative sense of a formidable or momentous matter is represented.
The technical sense of an essential part or fundamental is represented.
The mountain adjective is represented.
The personal sense of firmness and composure is represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference to رَكْنٌ.
The local chief or headman meaning is represented.
The leather vessel or washing tub meaning is represented.
The general adjective for having corners or angles is represented.
The specialized udder description is represented.

cautions: The QAC verb group is the canonical Form I active imperfect تَرْكَنُ; the reported passive Form IV reading is retained as a Quranic constructional note rather than counted as an additional QAC form.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:rkn:24376:g1:main reports an attributed Form II meaning 'to make like' but explicitly states that the meaning belongs to زكّن; the evidence is therefore retained as unresolved rather than presented as a meaning of ركن.
